blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. and former Vice President Leni Robredo were dragged into the impeachment trial of Vice President Sara Duterte as the defense team presented documents showing their business interests listed in their statements of assets, liabilities and net worth (SALNs). Duterte has been accused of amassing unexplained wealth, failing to truthfully disclose all her assets, and participating in business.
